title: CJK text docx 001
notes: real public-domain Chinese tang poetry: Li Bai 静夜思 (床前明月光…故乡) and Meng Haoran 春晓 (春眠不觉晓…多少), 4 lines each, one paragraph per line; every run carries an explicit eastAsia font hint w:rFonts w:eastAsia="Noto Serif CJK SC" injected as raw w:rPr via parse_xml (python-docx font.name only writes ascii/hAnsi). Reference text is the exact inserted strings; downstream F1 applies the C9 §10.6 CJK per-char tokenization rule.
